operations.object: On 30 June 2017, the 13 th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court granted the request, referring to the ruling of the General Assembly of 7 July 2015 which had annulled the Fund’s decision of 13 January 2011 concerning the valuation of Viva TV-Radio Viva (see paragraph 29 above).
